mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, which leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within a month signals strengthening supply-side conditions, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE remains below 4% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and decrease in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals improving economic conditions with controlled inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases and CPIAUCSL decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where GDPC1 increases and CPIAUCSL decreases simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% for three consecutive months signals accommodative monetary policy, which boosts equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS remains below 1% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both increase simultaneously.
